title: naknigu — articles for your e-reader
link.paired: The phone is linked to the e-reader.
link.unpaired: This phone is not linked to an e-reader. Open {url} on the e-reader and scan the QR code on its screen. Your articles and reading progress stay on the phone.

notice.already: This article is already in the list.
notice.storage_full: The phone storage is full: the article text will be loaded again next time.
status.from_storage: Taking the article from the phone storage…
status.fetching_page: Asking the server to download the page…
status.checking_links: Checking the links in the article…
link.request: The e-reader asks to open a link:
settings.notify: When “Open on the phone” is chosen on the e-reader, the link can arrive as a notification:

errors.bad_url: this does not look like a page address. Paste the full link, for example https://habr.com/ru/articles/891426/
errors.private_address: the address is in a private network
errors.timeout: the site did not answer in time
errors.not_html: this is not a web page
errors.too_many_requests: too many requests, try again in a minute
errors.not_paired: the e-reader is not linked to this phone yet
